description: 9 exemplars (1 de), 7 near-misses, 2 counterexamples. The exemplars are the account-lifecycle entry points a consumer actually asks through — sign-up, verification, reset, storage, MFA, passkey, session, logout, and 'add login with Google', which was a should-trigger for no skill before this set existed. The near-misses are this skill's own four 'Do NOT use when' routes plus request validation and two non-auth uses of "session": each belongs to a sibling that answers a different question. The counterexamples carry no security vocabulary at all and guard against over-triggering on ordinary engineering work.
